next.reason: 1985: "Argument-1 must be a nonnumeric literal or alphanumeric data item whose content has one of the following two formats"; 2023: "Argument-1 shall be of category alphanumeric or national.". The content formats match in substance (optional spaces, sign, currency, digits, CR/DB). 2023 also accepts national arguments, which 1985 refused, and adds a LOCALE alternative.
